name: signbridge-monorepo
description: SignBridge — Full-Stack Hand Gesture Recognition & Translation System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm.cmd run dev -w backend" "npm.cmd run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm.cmd run build -w shared && npm.cmd run build -w backend && npm.cmd run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm.cmd run start -w backend" "npm.cmd run preview -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm.cmd run test -w backend && npm.cmd run test -w frontend
